name: krambuhl
description: Agent-loop substrate: commons (foundation), loom (projects), guild (panels), ev (loops), and the agent-loop-full meta-bundle.

plugins.name: commons
plugins.description: Cross-cutting skills (grill-me, find-skills, review-skill, write-as-me, pr-comments) and skill-activation hooks. Usable on its own; the other plugins in this marketplace also pull it in.

plugins.name: guild
plugins.description: Panel substrate: guild-validate / guild-plan / guild-spawn skills + guild CLI + plan-* / research-* / evaluator-* / implementer-* / fixer-* agents.

plugins.name: loom
plugins.description: Project substrate: loom-* skills + loom CLI for plans, research, sessions, checkins, retros, archives.

plugins.name: ev
plugins.description: Execution loops: ev-loop-confidence (tiered transforms), ev-loop-interactive (paired units), ev-run (router).

plugins.name: agent-loop-full
plugins.description: Meta-bundle: zero-content plugin that cascade-installs the full agent-loop family (commons, guild, loom, ev).
